intents: I think I need a hearing test.
I'm a veteran with a VA referral.
My hearing aid needs a repair or batteries.
I want to know what it will cost.
I'm looking for hours and directions.
firstVisit: A conversation about where hearing is hard for you.
A look in your ears for wax or anything that needs a physician.
The hearing test: soft sounds, speech in quiet and noise, middle ear.
Results explained in plain language, with your options.
services: A full diagnostic test, read by a Doctor of Audiology.
Fitted to your hearing and your life, then adjusted until right.
Walk in during office hours, any brand, wherever you bought it.
Evaluation and management for ringing in the ears.
Safe removal in the office when wax blocks hearing.
Swim, music, work, and range protection made for your ears.
For phones, television, and rooms where hearing aids are not enough.
vaSteps: Ask your VA primary care provider for an audiology referral to community care.
VA or TriWest schedules your visit, or you call us and email TriWest within 24 hours.
Bring your referral or authorization number and your VA ID.

review.text: The doctor is calm and takes his time.
review.source: A patient of ten years, Google review
